result.title: GeoNaviDiff: Transferring Disentangled Semantic Controls to Diffusion Features via Local Riemannian Navigation
result.summary: Disentangled real-image manipulation requires factor-specific semantic control while preserving image fidelity and non-target content. StyleSpace $S$ provides interpretable controls but is limited by GAN inversion, whereas diffusion models offer stronger image realization without an explicit factorized control basis. We introduce GeoNaviDiff, an unsupervised cross-space framework that transfers disentangled StyleSpace interventions to local Riemannian trajectories in diffusion $h$-space. GeoNaviDiff constructs reconstruction-decoupled supervision by extracting a spherical Log-map tangent from a matched StyleGAN reconstruction-edit pair and parallel-transporting it to the real-image diffusion state. A shared, factor-conditioned Navigator predicts this tangent at inference, while norm-preserving geodesic realization and source-anchored rollout stabilize the reverse process without edited references or factor-specific models. Experiments across multiple datasets show that GeoNaviDiff outperforms the compared methods in fidelity, factor selectivity, edit locality, and trajectory smoothness.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 GeoNaviDiff，一个无监督跨空间框架：从 StyleGAN 重建—编辑对中提取球面 Log-map 切向量，平行迁移到真实图像的扩散 h 空间，用共享的因子条件 Navigator 预测该切向并沿保范测地线实现真实图像的可分解语义编辑。
AI.relevance_reason: 其把语义干预方向作为切向量在隐空间迁移、并靠「保范测地实现 + 源锚定 rollout」稳定状态轨迹的做法，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 推理状态的更新方向可控性与防坍缩稳定化。
